title: V-8 ENGINE 350 CU. IN. SPEC. HI PERF. HOOD PAINT STRIPE
summary: LT1 hood (special high-performance 350): painted hood stripes that outline the raised center section (power bulge) and run back to points at the rear (cowl) end of the hood, plus the 'LT-1' hood decal on the stripe. Sections A-A and B-B give stripe widths and offsets from the hood edge and tangent line. Nothing is bolted on this sheet.

parts.name: CHART
parts.name_expanded: Chart – hood paint stripe (stripe color/layout chart)

fastening.to: hood panel [1], between the paint stripes ahead of the rear of the hood bulge
fastening.note: Decal [2] (reads 'LT-1') is applied on the hood stripe area beside the hood center bulge, near the .20 dimension; no fastener (adhesive decal, no material code given).

notes: Stripe dimensions (main view): 3.30 at the rear end; 2.69 and .20 at the decal area.
SECTION A-A: stripe bands .10, .10, .16 / .10, .10; .60; .16; .06; 7.86 REF. from TANGENT LINE to HOOD EDGE.
SECTION B-B: 1.10, .10, .10; .10, .10, .28; 5.56; .28; 7.60 REF. from HOOD EDGE to TANGENT LINE.
Circled grid/station references on the hood: C (centerline), 10, 25, +5.
